verified_source_fact: child_pipe caches one process-wide PIPE_FS handle to the NamedPipe filesystem; it persists until process exit. An uncaptured child does not initialize it.

retained_owner_cost.verified_fact: std Child retains both the process HANDLE and main-thread HANDLE. wait only queries the process wait state and exit code; neither handle closes until Process drops. A retained Child plus one Job therefore owns exactly three handles.
retained_owner_cost.adaptation: The failed-Drop/retry control subtracts exactly these three identified owners from its pre-Drop count. This is an ownership-cost correction, with strict equality preserved; it does not explain or allow unrelated cold initialization deltas.
